articles.summary: Tenaris is now domestically producing its TN 95EY proprietary steel grade, responding to the evolving needs of Western Canadian energy operators. Produced in Tenaris’s Sault Ste. Marie Industrial Centre in Ontario, the new steel grade is designed for demanding oil and gas applications, including wells where operators face conditions with high pressure and temperature, making it well suited to demanding sour service applications and unconventional plays in the Montney and Duvernay formations.
articles.title: Tenaris now producing new proprietary steel grade in Canada

articles.summary: The Vaca Muerta shale formation in Neuquén, Argentina, continues to unlock new opportunities while raising the bar for what the local energy industry needs. For Tenaris, the answer lies in staying close to its customers, combining experience across different markets, and translating that knowledge into products and services tailored to local operational needs.
articles.title: Tenaris shares its Vaca Muerta vision at the Shale in Argentina event in Houston

articles.summary: Shellie Clark, Operations Director for Tenaris in Canada, joined manufacturing leaders from across the country at the Powering Production: Championing Women in Manufacturing Forum, where she participated in the panel discussion, Workplace Champions and Allies – Accelerating Women’s Success in Manufacturing.
articles.title: Shellie Clark shares leadership insights at Women in Manufacturing Forum

articles.summary: Tenaris supplied TenarisHydril BlueDock® connectors featuring Automated Anti-Rotational Key (AARK) technology, to support the installation of 30" conductor and 20" surface casing strings during a major offshore development project in deepwater conditions on the UK Continental Shelf.
articles.title: TenarisHydril BlueDock ® with AARK supports safe and efficient offshore drilling operations

articles.summary: Tenaris will host a series of technical and industry-focused panel discussions at ROG.e 2026 (Rio Oil & Gas Expo and Conference), one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
articles.title: Industry leaders join Tenaris for technical panels at ROG.e 2026

articles.summary: Originally from Ipatinga, in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais, Bárbara Emerick Dias' industrial connection began early. Growing up near a steel facility and watching her father's work in the manufacturing sector helped spark her interest in engineering.
articles.title: The resilience behind an engineer's rise from trainee to Operations Manager at Tenaris
